verdict.rationale: 1Password documents official SDKs for Go, JavaScript and Python for building integrations that interact with 1Password programmatically. The docs cover loading secrets through secret references or Environments and managing items, and an official GitHub repo (onepassword-sdk-js) backs this up. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 1Password SDKs allow you to build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password using Go, JavaScript, or Python.
Automate item management: Programmatically manage items in your 1Password account.
Load secrets into your code with secret references or read environment variables from 1Password Environments.
Build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password.
